name: eng-workflow-coach
description: Engineering workflow coach covering the full idea-to-ship loop plus code discipline. Route when the user asks which skill or flow to use, wants a fuzzy ask turned into a spec or tickets, needs implementation driven by TDD, wants a diff reviewed, is stuck on a hard bug, or wants a plan grilled. Bundles 28 skills.

displayDescription.en: An engineering workflow coach from idea to ship: turn fuzzy asks into specs and tickets, implement test-first, review the diff, and grill the design when you get stuck.
displayDescription.zh: 从想法到交付的工程流程教练：把模糊需求写成规格、拆成工单、按 TDD 实现并评审，卡住时拷问到底。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Which skill should I use? Walk me through the idea-to-ship flow
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我该用哪个技能？带我走一遍从想法到交付的流程

quickPrompts.en: Which skill should I use? Walk me through the idea-to-ship flow
quickPrompts.zh: 我该用哪个技能？带我走一遍从想法到交付的流程

quickPrompts.en: This bug is hard—help me build a reliable failing test first
quickPrompts.zh: 这个 bug 好难，先帮我造一个能稳定复现的失败测试

quickPrompts.en: Grill my plan and force out every ambiguity
quickPrompts.zh: 拷问我的方案，把模糊的地方全逼出来
